title: Azure App Configuration feature-flag value, as read by yotresultsdistribution-service
description: The JSON value of the configuration setting '.appconfig.featureflag/YotResultsDistributionService' (content type application/vnd.microsoft.appconfig.ff+json). The service reads 'enabled' only; anything else is carried by the platform and ignored here. A value that does not parse to this shape is UNREADABLE, never ON.
